item.title: An initial investigation into WDDM on ReactOS
item.description:
📝 Today we talk about WDDM, or the Windows Display Driver Model. This is just a normal XDDM display driver that does nothing except write to blank memory. This isn’t the only Vista+ feature that has this requirement.
🔗 Read more: https://reactos.org/blogs/investigating-wddm/
